purpose: Column definitions for Tables A, B and C. WP0 exits only when every planned column has a definition, a unit, a provenance rule and a source.

missing_data.not_applicable: em dash. Used where a quantity has no meaning for that method, e.g. stage counts for a single-stage method. Never zero.
missing_data.unavailable: the literal token unavailable. Used where a quantity exists but the source does not report it and it cannot be inferred.
missing_data.censored: the token CAP HIT, with the bound, e.g. > Nmax. Never accompanied by a speedup.

signed_error.rule: the sign is always shown; absolute error alone is not reportable

stage_counts.rule: Stage 1 + Stage 2 = Total is asserted and printed for every staged method in all three tables
stage_counts.single_stage: em dash for both stage columns, never zero

deltas.definition: every delta is controlled minus native
deltas.rule: relative deltas are archived alongside absolute deltas

frequency_units.rule: the table states the unit and whether the source reports angular or cyclic frequency; a source reporting cyclic frequency is converted and the conversion is marked inferred

iteration_commensurability.rule: iteration counts are commensurable only within a method. Cross-method comparison is on wall time only. This is stated in the caption of every table that prints an iteration column.

table_A.question: Can each published method be reproduced from its source?

columns.name: Method
columns.definition: method identifier

columns.name: Case / mesh
columns.definition: source-paper case identifier and its native mesh

columns.name: omega1 ours
columns.definition: first natural frequency of our reproduction, on the design the source evaluates its published frequency on

columns.name: omega1 paper
columns.definition: the source's published first natural frequency

columns.name: Signed relative error
columns.definition: see conventions.signed_error

columns.name: Topology agreement
columns.definition: preregistered field metric and solid-region IoU where a density field is available; documented digitization where only an image is available; otherwise unavailable

columns.name: Native iterations ours
columns.definition: iterations executed under the source's own protocol and stopping rule

columns.name: Published iterations
columns.definition: the source's iteration count
columns.provenance_rule: reported, inferred with interval, or unavailable; label required

columns.name: rho_iter
columns.definition: iteration-count fidelity ratio, iterations_ours / iterations_paper, with interval when the reference is inferred

columns.name: Stage 1
columns.definition: iterations in the method's first native stage

columns.name: Stage 2
columns.definition: iterations in the method's second native stage

columns.name: Total
columns.definition: Stage 1 + Stage 2, asserted equal to the reported total

columns.name: Native runtime ours
columns.definition: locally measured wall time under the native protocol; descriptive only

columns.name: Provenance
columns.definition: aggregate provenance marks for the row's reference values

columns.name: Verdict
columns.definition: fidelity verdict assigned mechanically by the frozen rule

prohibited: a source-paper runtime may not appear in this table, nor in any column that invites comparison with local controlled runtime

table_B.question: Under identical external engineering requirements, how much computation does each implementation require?
table_B.permitted_claim: controlled runtime and speedup, worded per the comparator's Table A verdict

columns.name: Method
columns.definition: method identifier

columns.name: Mesh
columns.definition: common mesh

columns.name: omega1 raw
columns.definition: first natural frequency at the accepted design, evaluated on the raw physical density field

columns.name: omega1 binarized
columns.definition: first natural frequency at the accepted design after volume-preserving binarization

columns.name: Stage 1
columns.definition: accepted iterations in the first native stage

columns.name: Stage 2
columns.definition: accepted iterations in the second native stage

columns.name: k_cont
columns.definition: iteration at which the last mandatory continuation transition and any minimum-polish requirement were cleared; the schedule floor below which acceptance is impossible

columns.name: Total k*
columns.definition: accepted iteration, the end of the W-iteration confirmation window

columns.name: Runtime
columns.definition: median wall time of the timed replays to k*, from entry into method-specific initialization through the accepted update and one common terminal validation

columns.name: Speedup
columns.definition: ratio of runtimes within this campaign against the stated baseline
columns.note: wording bound to the comparator's Table A verdict; uncertainty combines timing dispersion and k* dispersion

columns.name: d_inf
columns.definition: max over elements of |xPhys(k) - xPhys(k-1)| at k*

columns.name: rV
columns.definition: |V(xPhys) - Vtarget| / Vtarget at k*

columns.name: Grayness
columns.definition: mean of 4*x*(1-x) over the physical density field at k*; reported only, never a gate

columns.name: Acceptance
columns.definition: accepted, or the censoring reason

table_C.question: How much does replacing the native protocol with the controlled protocol change each method?
table_C.permitted_claim: within-method protocol sensitivity only; no cross-method ranking

columns.name: Method
columns.definition: method identifier

columns.name: Mesh
columns.definition: mesh available to both arms

columns.name: Native Stage 1/2/Total
columns.definition: iterations under the frozen source-native protocol on the common problem

columns.name: Benchmark Stage 1/2/Total
columns.definition: iterations under the Table B protocol and common acceptance rule

columns.name: Native runtime
columns.definition: locally measured wall time, native arm

columns.name: Benchmark runtime
columns.definition: locally measured wall time, controlled arm

columns.name: Native omega1
columns.definition: first natural frequency, native arm, common terminal evaluator

columns.name: Benchmark omega1
columns.definition: first natural frequency, controlled arm, common terminal evaluator

columns.name: Delta iterations
columns.definition: controlled minus native

columns.name: Delta runtime
columns.definition: controlled minus native

columns.name: Delta omega1
columns.definition: controlled minus native

prohibited: a paper runtime measured on other hardware is never an input to this table
